messages:
dina_pm: Quick sync — need alignment on multi-region routing + tenant isolation roadmap. Customer asks: region pinning, per-tenant commit, explicit failover. Propose 3 isolation tiers and routing precedence. Thoughts?

anil_arch: +1 for 3 tiers: 1) shared (best-effort), 2) logical-isolation (soft quotas, sticky KV/cache affinity), 3) dedicated (reserved GPU pools). Routing precedence idea: latency_slo -> region_pin -> capacity_tier -> cost_tier. Fallbacks must be composable.

clare_prod: From customers we've heard two distinct asks: BankCorp wants VPC + guaranteed throughput (hard SLA) for a subset of routes. IndieApp wants low-latency multi-region failover. For launch criteria we need: docs/playbook, two paying pilots (one enterprise, one mid-market), billing hook, and SLA language.

lee_infra: Implementation notes: we'll need per-tenant queue isolation and token-bucket shaping, autoscaler safety limits for dedicated pools, and an eviction policy for logical isolation. Telemetry requirements: 50/95/99/99.9 latencies per tenant/model/route, plus per-tenant queued requests and tail-CPU on GPUs.

maria_sre: Ops considerations: oncall playbooks for cross-region failover, automated rollback thresholds, cost-override alerts, and data residency checks during failovers. Also require a circuit-breaker to prevent uncontrolled cross-region spill.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z against product/canary group (small internal + customer pilot group).

dina_pm: Draft routing policy example snippet (for conversation):

```json
{
  "route": "model.chat",
  "precedence": ["latency_slo","region_pin","capacity_tier","cost_tier"],
  "isolation_tier": "logical-isolation",
  "cache_affinity": true,
  "fallbacks": ["region_failover","cheaper_model"]
}
```

anil_arch: Add a `kv_cache_affinity` toggle so we can prioritize cache locality during failover. Also suggest explicit `eviction_policy` field for logical isolation (e.g., `throttle`, `drop_oldest`, `migrate`).

clare_prod: Customer-facing onramp checklist (proposal): security review, SLA & billing terms, performance baseline (7 days of production traffic), acceptance gates (error_rate < 0.3%, 99p latency < 250ms), and a migration window. Recommend we require a pilot of at least 7 days with synthetic spike test before full cutover.

lee_infra: Risk note: logical-isolation reduces blast radius but does not eliminate noisy-neighbor CPU/GPU contention. We should mandate a pre-flight stress test (10x expected QPS) and an observability baseline. Also need a capacity-preview API so sales/customer success can show projected headroom for a tenant.

maria_sre: Action items: create runbook draft (owner @maria_sre), telemetry dashboard (owner @lee_infra), policy-DSL proposal (owner @anil_arch), and product onramp checklist doc (owner @clare_prod). Target: pilot signups open by end of Q3, pilot start in early Q4.

dina_pm: I'll capture these items in the PRD and schedule a stakeholder sync next Tue to lock launch criteria and pilot customers. If anyone has objections, flag now — otherwise I'll post the PRD link here later today. :thumbsup:
